sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claims"."Policy_ID" AS e, SUM(("Claims"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claims"."Amount_Settled")) AS m1 FROM "Claims" GROUP BY "Claims"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m2 DESC LIMIT 10
why: amount claimed - amount settled: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one claim on a policy
total of amount claimed minus amount settled per Customer_Policies (by Policy_ID) (additive)
share of the all total of total of amount claimed minus amount settled (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Claims"."Policy_ID" AS e, AVG((CAST(("Claims"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claims"."Amount_Settled") AS REAL) / "Claims"."Amount_Settled")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "Claims" GROUP BY "Claims"."Policy_ID"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claims.relative difference of amount claimed from amount settled
why: (amount claimed - amount settled) / amount settled: the relative difference of two quantities in USD
average of relative difference of amount claimed from amount settled per Customer_Policies (by Policy_ID)
share of the all total of number of Claims records (all level)
